position_outside: UN/LOCODE places the port at (51.2167, 4.4167), in the city about 1.35 km from these limits, which are cut to the water.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals and way 1143855241, way 1143855256, way 1143855243, way 1143855260, way 48605572 from OpenStreetMap, grown by 1500 m, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it (the sea within its coastline, rivers, docks and basins), with the terminals and those areas kept whole
properties.disjoint: Katoen Natie's site, which has no berth (see its inland), is four pieces of land away from the water, and the Katoen Natie warehouse by the city is kept whole away from the docks' water, so each is a part of its own.
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Antwerp. These are the hull of the terminals below, four docks (Hansadok, Leopolddok, Vierde and Zesde Havendok) and a Katoen Natie warehouse by the city, grown by 1.5 km, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it, with the terminals and those areas kept whole and a 30 m margin where they meet the water. A scan of OpenStreetMap finds no homes or hospitals inside. In the docks of the Eilandje, the Kerkschip Sint-Jozef, a church ship, is moored inside the limits, with the quarter's label 60 m inside the edge and a school point, Hondenboot Antwerpen vzw, on the edge; the edges of three residential areas reach in by about 840 m² in all, none of it more than 10 m inside.
